verdict.rationale: Dover documents a one-off CSV export of candidate data, fixed built-in reporting charts (Funnel Conversion, Time to Hire, Hires by Source) that can be saved as PNG or shared, and a general API with a machine-readable spec plus outbound webhooks that can move data out programmatically. There is no evidence of a custom report builder, scheduled or recurring exports, BI or warehouse connectors, or a reporting-specific API; the CSV export is a manual one-off action, not a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: custom report building, scheduled/recurring exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a documented reporting/analytics API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: Export your candidate data to a CSV from **Settings → Data Export**.
Click the three dots on any chart to **Save as PNG**, open a **Full screen view**, or **Share** the chart.
With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
The full machine-readable specification is available at [app.dover.com/docs/api.json](https://app.dover.com/docs/api.json).
Webhooks send an HTTPS request from Dover to a URL you choose when something happens.
